**Finding: MISSING (critical) — no indemnification provision anywhere in the Agreement.**

- Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "claim" returned nothing; the body runs from Section 9 (Warranties, p0055–p0058) directly into Section 10 (General Provisions, p0059). Section 9 contains only corporate-authority reps and a Globix carve-out — no IP or conduct-based protection.
- This is walk-away territory under INDEMN: HDI develops, hosts and distributes the Site and handles Content and user data, yet bears no defense obligation for third-party IP claims against the platform, its breach of law, data incidents, or its gross negligence/willful misconduct.
- Redline validated (ok:true): a new Section 9A inserted after p0058 adding (i) HDI's indemnity covering IP infringement by the Site/HDI-supplied technology, HDI's breach of law, unauthorized disclosure of Content or user data caused by HDI, and its gross negligence/willful misconduct; (ii) a deliberately narrow Company indemnity limited to the Content and Marks we supply and our own breach of law; and (iii) standard notice/control/cooperation procedure with consent required for settlements binding the indemnified party.
- Fallback available in negotiation: usual IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations, specifications) and procure/modify/replace remedies.
